title: Silver Plus Saver vs Silver Saver Account: What is the difference?
summary: This document compares Silver Plus Saver and Silver Saver by detailing Silver Plus Saver’s higher monthly withdrawal allowance (up to 20 free withdrawals/month) and its Tier 2 APY eligibility threshold ($25,000 balance). It also notes that exceeding free withdrawals triggers standard excess-withdrawal handling per account terms, and that Silver Saver uses a different threshold listed in its own terms.
